title: End-to-End Tokenization with Receipts and Hashes: A Complete, Self-Anchored Loop Demonstration on Bitcoin Mainnet (October 18, 2026)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: This work was produced inside an AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Every claim is backed by a timestamped, publicly committed receipt trail. Errors are disclosed, not erased. Limitations are load-bearing.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects. All battery payloads are synthetic. Nothing herein is investment, legal, or financial advice.

THE FULL LOOP, END TO END: a patent artifact reduced to a 32-byte seed; sealed permanently on Bitcoin mainnet (block 972023, tx 97d8cd38...); reconstructed byte-identically in a keyless browser viewer (deterministic-code-dsos.base44.app/genesis-viewer); the IP portfolio ledger anchored by digest (block 972026, tx 549bcf47...); ownership of the custody satoshis transferred wallet A to fresh wallet B and back (txs 1f550498... and c850f1d4..., confirmed block 972031) with the asset hash re-anchored in every transfer — the asset itself never moving once — and a downloadable, verifiable receipt at every step. In the closing act, THIS ARTICLE's own SHA-256 digest (4344dcba6310bfbdbc2cc3f189c29117a9caead21299f607e6d39236aca4454a) was anchored on Bitcoin mainnet (tx 9276a041caf7ffbe0e7d470c2e714a531d6712fffdf73ef0b9c973678e0e2605): the article about receipts is itself a receipt. The paper also reports the honest cost economics of per-transaction anchoring and the Merkle-batched scaling answer (SIP-034-041, OpenTimestamps-compatible).

Anyone can verify, three ways: (1) DOI tier — every cited record is public on Zenodo; (2) Bitcoin tier — re-hash any anchored artifact and check the OP_RETURN anchor by txid on any block explorer; (3) Git tier — github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen, append-only since Sept 7 2026, corrections forward-only and disclosed.

Dual Mesh Benchmark status: MEASURED (scoped) — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241 (DeepSeek column); cross-engine expansion DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23348675.

Patent statuses: USPTO 19/693,343 pending; THREADZERO 64/081,490 pending; priority relationship subject to counsel confirmation and not asserted. Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit authorization (owner chat authorization, 2026-10-18).
